facts.fact: A pilot of the 4th general population and housing census ran October to November 2025 in four localities (Bamenda 1, Fongo Tongo, Buea, Mora) with UNFPA support, and 49 agents and supervisors were trained on digital collection tools.
Recruitment of 32,059 enumerators for the 4th census was under way, with a budget of 13.28 billion FCFA and fieldwork due to start 24 April 2026; the document is dated 11 March 2026.
